description: This file defines React components for a toggle group UI element using the Radix UI primitive toggle group. It manages context for shared variant and size properties, and exports ToggleGroup and ToggleGroupItem components.

methods.name: ToggleGroup
methods.description: React component that renders a toggle group with shared context for variant and size.

methods.name: ToggleGroupItem
methods.description: React component that renders an item within the toggle group, utilizing context and variant props.
